data.name: Khadijahh
data.gender_notes: Khadijahh is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Khadijahh is the name of the honorable wife of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). She was a wealthy businesswoman and the first person to accept Islam as a faith. Her faith and support were crucial for the early spread of Islam. The name Khadijahh carries the meaning “Wife of Prophet Muhammad” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khadijahh usually hope their child will grow to embody wife of prophet muhammad and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Model of faith and support in Islam
data.etymology: Khadijahh belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wife of Prophet Muhammad.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khadijahh total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: Khadijahh's acceptance of Islam marked a significant shift in the social and political landscape of Mecca. Her status as a wealthy and respected member of society meant that her conversion influenced many others to consider the new faith. In addition, her role as a wife and a mother during this time provided a model for later Muslim families.
data.spiritual_significance: Khadijahh is known as the "Mother of Believers" in Islamic tradition. Her unwavering faith and support for Muhammad during his early days as a prophet was essential for his success in spreading the message of Islam. Her acceptance of the faith, and her character as an exemplary wife and mother, continue to inspire and provide a model for Muslim women today. In addition, her relationship with Muhammad demonstrates the importance of a strong and supportive spouse in one's spiritual journey.
